posts.trend: Landlord withholds security deposit ‘till new tenant found’, Bengaluru man wins Rs 90,000
posts.context: Moving out requires you to do the operational work of a real estate agency just to extract your own money.
posts.angle: You become an unpaid property broker for the man who charged you for normal wear and tear.
slides: "Deposit tabhi milega jab naya banda aayega."

You cleaned the kitchen fan.
You replaced the bath fitting.
You interviewed four potential tenants on flatmates group.
You did his broker's job for three weeks.

He sent a thumbs-up emoji at 11 PM.

The money is still in his liquid fund.
posts.caption: Every tenant in Indiranagar knows this exact WhatsApp voice note.
posts.rank_verdict: The middle escalation reads a bit like a task list before the sharp landing rescues the post.
